861:t_121:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well then, everyone! Let's give it our all again with hard work and guts!」

861:t_122:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I got shot down again... Taking the money from this stage and subtracting the repair costs, let's see, that leaves a grand total of 1,500 yen...」

861:t_122:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「You're bad at this, $$ノノ$$. If you pull back units that are about to be shot down, or pick Evade or Guard, your chances of surviving go up.」

861:t_122:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「And on top of that, don't just use 'Gain' and 'Vigor'. Use 'Alert' and 'Persist' too, okay?」

861:t_122:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「You... Don't tell me you only know 'Gain' and 'Vigor'...!? Typical Dumbatross...!」

861:t_122:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I hope all you players will make full use of Spirit Commands and enjoy SRW, okay?」

861:t_122:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well then, everyone! Let's give it our all again with hard work and guts!」

861:t_123:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ here~! Put us two together, and we're Nononoriko~!」

861:t_123:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Is that no good? I thought it was a nice duo name, kind of like $$ノノリリ$$...」

861:t_123:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And if our spirits get even higher, we'd turn into Groovy Nononoriko, and if she went out to a field, she'd become Field Groovy Nononoriko, and then...」

861:t_123:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh no! $$ノリコ$$'s Morale is dropping! We have to let her rest a little!」

861:t_123:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well then, everyone! Please support Nonononono... um... Nononoriko again!」

861:t_124:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are you two doing with those toys...?」

861:t_124:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノリコ$$ lent them to me! There's even a $$ディスヌフ$$! $$ノリコ$$! Can Big Sis play with us too?」

861:t_124:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That can wait! Right now we have to greet the players, look...!」

861:t_124:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're right! Then! Players! Good work today!」

861:t_124:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's do a Lightning Kick together with you!」

861:t_125:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are you two doing with those toys...?」

861:t_125:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノリコ$$ lent them to me! There's even a $$ディスヌフ$$! $$ノリコ$$! Can Big Sis play with us too?」

861:t_125:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That can wait! Right now we have to greet the players, look...!」

861:t_125:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're right! Then! Players! Good work today!」

861:t_125:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's do a Lightning Kick together with you!」

861:t_126:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I've probably never seen a god...」

861:t_126:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If even gods have wishes, who are they supposed to wish to...?」

861:t_126:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「People fight to make their wishes come true... But a wall always rises up before them...」

861:t_126:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And yet, people fight... believing in the future overflowing with light that lies beyond...」

861:t_126:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen'. 'A Miracle Worth 12,000 Years'...」

861:t_126:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「How was that, Big Sis! Even $$ノノ$$ can do a proper, soulful one if she tries!」

861:t_127:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Save data storage confirmed.」

861:t_127:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「After the game ends, the player is entitled to free sleep and free food and drink.」

861:t_127:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「However, your mission is not complete. A swift return to the front is expected.」

861:t_128:3.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「So you're suspending the game. Hee hee, this is a fine opportunity.」

861:t_128:4.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「While you're away from SRW, I can pursue my pirate trade without interference. I shall make the most of this gap and earn as much as I can.」

861:t_128:5.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「If you dislike that, you had better come back soon. Not that I care whether you can stop me once you do.」

861:t_128:6.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Now then, do get a good rest.」

861:t_129:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Good work, $$ピニオン$$. Delivery of your game software.」

861:t_129:4.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Oh, it finally came! '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen'!」

861:t_129:5.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Man, quite a while has passed since the release date, but I finally got my hands on it!」

861:t_129:6.en:
$$エイミー$$
「If you wanted it so badly on release day, you should have bought the download version.」

861:t_129:7.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「There's a way to sell it like that!?」

861:t_129:8.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Players who don't want to end up like $$ピニオン$$, be sure to check the official Super Robot Wars site!」

861:t_129:9.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Later, everyone! I'm going to jump in right away, too!」

861:t_130:3.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「How's it going, $$レド$$? How far have you gotten in Super Robot Wars?」

861:t_130:4.en:
$$レド$$
「It is hard... Game Over comes, fast.」

861:t_130:5.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Ha ha ha! You can handle a tin can, but it looks like your game skills are so-so!」

861:t_130:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Tips. I want you to teach me.」

861:t_130:7.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Easy. Just make this great $$ピニオン$$ an ace pilot, and it's a cakewalk!」

861:t_130:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Skeptical proposal. You are not registered as a pilot within this Super Robot Wars.」

861:t_130:9.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ピニオン$$, no part for you.」

861:t_130:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Seriously!? Somebody give me a moment to shine already!」

861:t_131:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Thank you for your hard work, players, everyone.」

861:t_131:4.en:
$$レド$$
「$$エイミー$$, what are you doing?」

861:t_131:5.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I'm greeting all the players who enjoyed Super Robot Wars.」

861:t_131:6.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I know! Why don't you try it too, $$レド$$?」

861:t_131:7.en:
$$レド$$
「But... I... have never done it...」

861:t_131:8.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's okay. I'll teach you.」

861:t_131:10.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Okay then, players! Rest up well and come back to us!」

861:t_131:13.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Good work to you too, $$レド$$!」
